svg.title: Forge seam and its callers
svg.desc: The new trait sits between the CLI commands and the code host; the GitHub adapter is the only implementation that reaches the host, and the fake double is the only one that does not.

g.text: OSF CLI · COMMANDS AND THEIR CALLERS
FORGE SEAM · PROVIDER-NEUTRAL TRAIT AND RUN CODE
CODE HOST · PULL REQUESTS, REVIEWS, CHECKS
